summary: Gladia's Starter plan grants 50€ in free credits on signup — a one-time grant with no monthly reset, worth roughly 80+ hours of async (pre-recorded) transcription or 60+ hours of real-time transcription at current rates ($0.61/hr async, $0.75/hr real-time). Includes 30 real-time and 25 async concurrent requests, speaker diarization, 100+ languages. Once credits are used, top up a prepaid wallet or upgrade.
claim_steps: Sign up at https://gladia.io (Get started on the Starter plan).
50€ in free credits are granted once — no monthly reset.
After the grant is consumed, top up the prepaid wallet or upgrade to Growth.
